## ARETUM - Backend Developer

🔗 [Apply](https://apply.workable.com/aretum/j/809385FCD9)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend Developer providing technical support and enhancements in an Agile environment at Aretum. Utilizing expertise in Python, AWS, and RESTful APIs for client application maintenance.
Backend Developer providing technical support at Aretum
- Tech stack: AWS, Cloud, Django, Python, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript
- Provide expert technical support to maintain the client application
- Provide support for development, enhancements, accessibility, integration, optimization, and maintenance
- Ensure availability and correct operations
- Work within a sprint-based development cycle
- Utilize knowledge of the AWS cloud environment, Python backend and TypeScript front-end
- 5 years of backend development experience
- Bachelor’s Degree (3 years of additional experience is acceptable in lieu of a degree)
- Experience using modern software to prototype and deploy backend web applications
- Experience using web programming languages (e.g., Ruby, Python) and frameworks (e.g., Django, Rails)
- Experience developing and consuming web-based, RESTful APIs
- Experience working in a team environment that uses agile methodologies
- Experience authoring developer-friendly documentation
- Experience using version control systems

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend Developer providing technical support and enhancements in an Agile environment at Aretum. Utilizing expertise in Python, AWS, and RESTful APIs for client application maintenance.
Backend Developer providing technical support at Aretum
Role description:
- Provide expert technical support to maintain the client application
- Provide support for development, enhancements, accessibility, integration, optimization, and maintenance
- Ensure availability and correct operations
- Work within a sprint-based development cycle
- Utilize knowledge of the AWS cloud environment, Python backend and TypeScript front-end
Role requirements:
- 5 years of backend development experience
- Bachelor’s Degree (3 years of additional experience is acceptable in lieu of a degree)
- Experience using modern software to prototype and deploy backend web applications
- Experience using web programming languages (e.g., Ruby, Python) and frameworks (e.g., Django, Rails)
- Experience developing and consuming web-based, RESTful APIs
- Experience working in a team environment that uses agile methodologies
- Experience authoring developer-friendly documentation
- Experience using version control systems
- Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
- Proficiency with scalable search technology
- Competence in handling and scaling large data sets and their storage
- Experience communicating technical concepts to a non-technical audience
Benefits:
- Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

- Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

- Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)

AWS, Cloud, Django, Python, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript
